Ask Me Anything

Questions & answers

Style, scents, small business or life. Send a question and the best ones get answered in the journal.

Preview: questions start arriving once the site goes live. Until then, DM us on Instagram.

Thanks! This is a preview, so nothing was sent. On the live site your question lands in our inbox.
What perfume works for both day and evening?

Go for a soft woody or musky scent. Light enough for the office, warm enough for dinner. Two sprays at day, one more at night.

How do I stop new shoes from hurting?

Wear them at home with thick socks for an hour a day for three days, and put plasters on your heels before you go out.

Can I start selling online with no website?

Yes. Start on WhatsApp and Instagram, take clear photos in daylight, and send everyone to one link. That's why this site exists.

How do I choose a dress for my body shape?

Highlight your favourite part and keep everything else simple. Wrap dresses flatter almost everyone.

The fine print

Terms & policies

Simple rules so every order goes smoothly. Last updated 28 October 2026.

Terms of sale

All prices are in FCFA and include the product only. Delivery is charged separately (see Delivery).

An order is confirmed once we reply on WhatsApp to confirm stock, the total and the delivery details. If an item sells out before we confirm, we will tell you and offer another scent or cancel the order at no cost.

Our perfumes are sold under their own brand names (Mark Him, Maiden Anna, Olynpeák). Descriptions are a guide; every scent smells slightly different on each person’s skin.

By placing an order you agree to these terms. We may update them from time to time, and the version shown here on the day of your order applies.

Payment

We accept mobile money (MTN Mobile Money and Orange Money) and, where available, cash on delivery.

For mobile money, send payment only to +237 653 426 739, the number shown on this site, and only after we confirm your order. We will never ask for your PIN or secret code.

Cash-on-delivery orders that are refused at the door without a good reason may require payment upfront next time.

Delivery

Within our city, we usually deliver within 24 to 48 hours after confirmation. The delivery fee depends on your area and is agreed on WhatsApp before we send your order.

For other towns, we send by travel agency or courier. The customer pays the transport fee, and we share the receipt so you can collect your parcel.

Please check your parcel when it arrives. Once a parcel is handed over to you or to the agency, it is your responsibility.

Returns & refunds

For hygiene reasons, perfumes that have been opened, sprayed or had their seal removed cannot be returned.

If you receive the wrong item or a damaged or leaking bottle, message us on WhatsApp within 24 hours of delivery with a photo. Keep the item unused in its box. We will replace it or refund you in full, including delivery.

Refunds are sent by mobile money within 3 working days of approval.

Privacy

When you order, we receive your name, phone number and delivery area through WhatsApp. If you join our email list, we also keep your email address.

We use this information only to handle your orders, answer your questions and, if you agreed, send you news and offers. We never sell or share it, except with the delivery person or agency carrying your order.

Your basket is saved only on your own device so it is still there when you come back. Clearing your browser removes it.

You can ask us at any time to see or delete the information we hold about you, or to stop receiving messages. Just send “Delete my data” or “Stop” on WhatsApp.

Journal, Q&A & memberships

All articles, stories and tips on this site belong to Muse & Market. You are welcome to share links, but please do not copy or resell the content.

Questions you send may be answered publicly in the journal without your name, unless you ask us to use it.

When paid memberships open, their prices, renewal and cancellation terms will be shown here before anyone can join.

Contact

For any question about an order or these policies, message us on WhatsApp at +237 653 426 739. We reply every day between 8 am and 8 pm.
